name: Create OAuth Client
description: Create OAuth Client Create a new OAuth client for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients
Create a new OAuth client for an account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete OAuth Client
description: Delete OAuth Client Delete an OAuth client. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients/{oauth_client_id}

name: Delete Rotated OAuth Client Secret
description: Delete Rotated OAuth Client Secret Removes the old client secret after a rotation, keeping only the new one. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients/{oauth_client_id}/rotate_secret
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients/{oauth_client_id}/rotate_secret
Removes the old client secret after a rotation, keeping only the new one. Use this after you have updated your client configuration to use the new secret. The `has_rotated_secret` field on the client indicates whether there is an old secret to delete.
Required: account_id (path); oauth_client_id (path)

name: OAuth Client Details
description: OAuth Client Details Get details of a specific OAuth client. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients/{oauth_client_id}

name: List OAuth Clients
description: List OAuth Clients List all OAuth clients for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients
List all OAuth clients for an account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Rotate OAuth Client Secret
description: Rotate OAuth Client Secret Creates a second client secret so you can update your client configuration before deleting the old one. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients/{oauth_client_id}/rotate_secret
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients/{oauth_client_id}/rotate_secret
Creates a second client secret so you can update your client configuration before deleting the old one. The `has_rotated_secret` field on the client will be set to `true`.
Required: account_id (path); oauth_client_id (path)

name: Update OAuth Client
description: Update OAuth Client Update an existing OAuth client. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/oauth_clients/{oauth_client_id}
